plain: To be greater in weight, power or number

webster.text: To outweigh; to overpower by weight.

more.text: To overpower by stronger influence or moral power.
To exceed in weight; hence, to incline or descend, as the scale of a balance.
To exceed in influence or power; hence, to incline to one side.

example.quote: In a country consisting chiefly of the cultivators of land, where the rules of an equal representation obtain, the landed interest must, upon the whole, preponderate in the government.
